summary: Phase 2 feature batch (in-app chat + Leaflet map + property lat/lng) tested end-to-end. Backend: 63/63 pytest tests pass (18 new phase-2 tests + 19 phase-1 + 26 baseline). All chat cases verified — POST /api/chat/threads is idempotent per (tenant, landlord, property) tuple, returns 400 when landlord messages own property or property_id missing, 404 for unknown property, GET /api/chat/threads decorates other_name / other_verified / other_id for both tenant + landlord perspectives, GET /messages returns {thread, messages} and 403s for a 3rd user, POST /messages saves message, updates last_message + last_message_at, rejects empty text with 400 and outsider with 403. Property lat/lng: all 8 seed properties have populated lat/lng after migration, POST /api/properties auto-geocodes via Nominatim (verified populated for 'Mumbai' with lat=19.07/lng=72.87), explicit lat/lng honored. Phase-1 regressions all green — no drift in favorites, reviews, KYC, sort, available_only, auth, bookings, properties. Frontend: 10/10 critical flows verified on 390x844 mobile viewport. Tenant home shows top-right map icon (testID='home-map-btn') that navigates to /map; /map renders an iframe with Leaflet + OpenStreetMap tiles and 8 price-pin markers (₹7.5k … ₹55k). Landlord home does NOT show the map btn (matches spec 'top-right for tenants'). Property detail landlord card shows Message button for tenants, hidden for owner. Tapping Message creates/opens a thread and routes to /chat/{thread_id}; chat screen renders bubbles (mine right/green, theirs left/grey), input + send button work, and 5s polling correctly picks up landlord replies within ~6.5s. Profile > Messages navigates to /chat and lists conversations with correct last message. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) still emit — non-blocking.

issues: Persisting RN-Web deprecation warnings for 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' (non-blocking; pre-existing from phase 1).

React DOM warning: 'React does not recognize the testID prop' — non-blocking, appears once (likely a raw View/Text passing testID down to a nested element on web). Cosmetic only, no functional impact.

action_items: (Optional) Silence RN-Web deprecation warnings by migrating 'shadow*' style props -> 'boxShadow' and moving 'pointerEvents' prop into style. Same as phase-1 action-item; still open.

(Optional) Investigate the single 'React does not recognize the testID prop' console warning that appears once on the chat thread screen — likely stems from spreading testID onto a DOM element in a custom wrapper.

(Nice-to-have) Add a testID on the Leaflet iframe's inner popup 'View →' link so Playwright can assert the popup navigation to /property/{id}. Currently the iframe srcdoc is Leaflet-rendered and not addressable via testID.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: chat endpoints are cleanly implemented with proper 400/403/404 status codes, no sync blocking, no _id leakage (projection {'_id':0} used consistently).
server.py has grown to ~840 lines — approaching the 700-line advisory threshold; consider splitting chat/reviews/kyc/favorites into sub-routers.
Nominatim geocoding uses a 6-second timeout with a proper User-Agent header and gracefully falls back to lat=None on any exception — good defensive design.

The tenant/landlord relationship for a chat thread is inferred from the property's landlord_id — this correctly rules out landlord-messages-self, but it also means a landlord user viewing another landlord's property could technically create a thread as 'tenant' side. Not a real leak (their user_id becomes tenant_id) but the semantic is worth documenting.
list_threads correctly enriches other_name / other_verified via a single grouped users.find batched by other_ids — good perf.
Chat polling on the frontend is a simple setInterval(5s) via useEffect — no exponential backoff on error, which is acceptable for a demo but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Phase-2 tests create test threads on demo tenant+landlord+seed-property, a couple of TEST_ chat messages, and one TEST_geo_ property (auto-cleaned via DELETE at end of test). Chat threads/messages remain in DB (harmless, prefixed with TEST_ where user-facing). No production data modified.

New Phase-2 testIDs: home-map-btn, map-screen, map-back-btn, map-iframe, detail-message-btn, chat-index-screen, chat-index-back, chat-thread-<tid>, chat-thread-screen, chat-back-btn, msg-<msg_id>, chat-input, chat-send-btn, profile-messages. Token localStorage key on web is 'nf_token' (NOT 'nf.token'). Polling interval on /chat/{id} is 5000ms; wait ~6.5s to observe other-side messages.
rca_of_issue: No product bugs found. Only observation: on the first playwright pass, I initially used the wrong localStorage key ('nf.token') for auth injection; the app correctly bounced to /onboarding. Once switched to the actual key 'nf_token' (from /app/frontend/src/lib/token.ts), all authenticated flows worked. This is a test-agent-only observation, not an app bug.
